turnaround_reason: Global beauty/fragrance company (Prestige + Consumer Beauty) that fell from ~$4.47 to ~$2.59 on disappointing execution, a soft Consumer Beauty segment, and heavy leverage. The turnaround thesis rests on new leadership's 'Coty.Curated' simplification plan, a strategic review/potential divestiture of the mass Consumer Beauty and Brazil businesses, and a ~$840M net-debt reduction after monetizing the remaining Wella stake.
bullish_points: Deep value on cash flow: ~$363M TTM FCF and EV/EBITDA ~7.4x against a $2.28B market cap; trades at ~0.76x book
Real deleveraging: nearly $840M YoY net-debt reduction after fully monetizing the Wella stake in Dec 2025
Active self-help: Coty.Curated framework + strategic review of Consumer Beauty/Brazil could unlock a cleaner, prestige-fragrance-led business
Insider open-market buys in 2026 (VON BRETTEN $200K, CFO Mercier $13K); JAB (54% insider) remains a committed anchor
Prestige fragrance category has been resilient; gross margins strong at ~63%
bearish_points: Structural overhang: L'Oreal takes the Gucci license in 2028, removing a meaningful prestige-fragrance revenue stream
Balance sheet still stretched: total debt $3.3B, debt/equity ~98%, current ratio 0.75 (<1) - liquidity is tight
Recent quarters swung to GAAP losses (profit margin -10%); EPS misses (-132% and -729% surprises) show execution remains shaky
Revenue essentially flat (+1.3%); this is a margin/cost + portfolio story, not a growth story
'Recovering' technically but price is only ~3% above the 200d MA and rolled -8% over 30 days - fragile
catalyst: Q1 FY2027 earnings on Nov 5, 2026, plus any definitive announcement from the Consumer Beauty / Brazil strategic review (divestiture would be the real re-rate)
catalyst_timing: Nov 5, 2026 earnings; strategic-review outcome timing open-ended
suggested_trade: Spot only, small speculative deep-value tranche. Options are liquid (call OI ~18k) so a modest Jan 2027 call could express the divestiture optionality, but the 2028 Gucci loss caps enthusiasm - keep it small.
key_risk: The Consumer Beauty strategic review stalls or divests at a fire-sale price, leverage stays elevated into the 2028 Gucci license loss, and the deep-value multiple is a trap rather than a floor.
would_skip_if: The strategic review is abandoned or the balance sheet forces an equity raise; either kills the thesis.
